content: सौत्र {%a.%} (-त्री|{%f.%}) [सूत्र-अण्] .²1 Belonging to or having a thread or string. .²2 Belonging to, mentioned, occurring or declared in, a Sūtra <ab>q. v.</ab> .{@-त्रः@} .²1 A Brāhmaṇa. .²2 An artificial root occurring in grammatical Sūtras which cannot be conjugated like a regular verb, but is used only to form derivative words.
